claimToPrecommit.provenance: Actual endpoint after parent precommit ACK, immediately before final schema and Git; includes research, coordination, heavy-slot queue and all checks.

semantics.concurrency: Same stable catalog, source library and destination paths. Per-file atomic publication and fresh-pass recovery; the complete generated tree is not a batch transaction.
semantics.refresh: Managed directories retain identity. Referenced available art creates or verifies exact symlinks, differing symlinks atomically replace, and obsolete generated symlinks and empty obsolete generated directories prune. Foreign regular files fail explicitly and remain intact.
semantics.staging: Each pass owns a unique public/.art-links-* directory outside every managed art directory. Finally removes its own staging only; hard OS termination can leave an inert private staging directory without changing the served art paths.
semantics.journey: Complete JSON stages then atomically renames to the owned journeys/imageId-extension.json path.
semantics.unchanged: Missing-art fallback, curated/source/tagged Exploration priority, served names, content selection and public linkArt API.

negativeProof.finalTestAssertionRefinement: The source remains exactly restored. Following lint, exit-code assertions use typed .toBe values rather than any-typed expected matcher objects; test cases and observable contracts are unchanged.

hostLoad.measuredFor: review-final actual review command-step start; Vitest initializes later
